primary_title: Molecular characterization of a cloned human oxytocin receptor
decision_basis: Oxytocin binds and activates cloned human OXTR in COS-1 cells and Xenopus oocytes, with high-affinity radioligand binding and receptor-dependent electrophysiological responses
limitations_preserved: Preserve human OXTR and COS-1/oocyte binding/electrophysiology context; Gq/Gi coupling and reproductive or CNS physiology are not generalized to SCI.

primary_title: Mustard oils and cannabinoids excite sensory nerve fibres through the TRP channel ANKTM1
decision_basis: Mustard-oil allyl isothiocyanate activates recombinant TRPA1/ANKTM1 channels and sensory neurons, linking the channel to irritant-evoked cation currents and nociception
limitations_preserved: Preserve electrophilic irritant and TRPA1 channel context; covalent agonism and sensory-neuron model do not imply SCI or terminal-TF function.
